each.description: With items: how each item appears in the blink. Set path for a bare value or fields for an object. Paths are relative to the item. Leave each out to show the whole item.

rkey.description: A record key, or a pattern where * stands for one or more characters, e.g. byjp.*

allow.description: add lets keys create new records.

fields.description: The top-level fields of the blink.

condition.description: CEL expression. The lens only covers records for which it is true.

newRecord.description: The object new records start from. Strings wrapped in {% %} are CEL expressions.

collection.description: The collection this lens covers, in this lens's repo.

main.description: Lets holders of a blinkers key read, change and optionally create selected records in this repo.

key.description: The field's name in the blink.

path.description: JSONPath (RFC 9535) selecting at most one value in the record.

allow.description: Changes callers may make. Leave it out to make the field read-only.

items.description: JSONPath (RFC 9535) selecting list items: a singular query followed by one filter or wildcard selector.

fields.description: Child fields; the blink shows an object.

newItem.description: With items: the object new items start from, before posted values are filled in. Strings wrapped in {% %} are CEL expressions.

field.description: One field of the blink. Set exactly one of path, items or fields.
